name: Resource Allocation
purpose: Allocate limited cognitive and operational resources among experiments designed by ACT32.
principle: NØX should not treat every possible action as equally valuable. It should allocate attention, observation, execution capacity and time according to expected learning value, evidence needs, reversibility, risk and resource efficiency.

selected_allocation.reason: Highest evidence-adjusted learning value under current resource constraints.

attention_plan.execution_policy: allocation_is_priority_not_permission; an experiment may execute only when its trigger, authorization and safety conditions are actually met

reallocation_rules: increase allocation when new evidence increases expected learning value
decrease allocation when repeated observations produce little new information
pause allocation when evidence contradicts the experiment assumptions
reallocate when a higher-value observable experiment appears
preserve reserve capacity for unexpected high-value evidence
never allocate financial spending under the current zero-cost policy
never allocate resources to Gemini or external paid AI
do not convert allocation into automatic execution permission
do not sacrifice evidence quality merely to increase activity
prefer measurable outcomes over activity volume
learning: Resources are finite even when financial cost is zero.
Attention and observation capacity should be allocated according to expected information gain.
A primary experiment should receive priority without monopolizing all available capacity.
A reserve protects NØX from missing unexpected high-value evidence.
Resource allocation is not equivalent to permission to execute an action.
next_cognitive_step: ACT34 should transform accumulated evidence and resource constraints into explicit goals that NØX can pursue and evaluate.
